objective: Show the newly requested delivery's own receipt and truthful transport-truck fuel/handling state; keep crew choices physically rear-bound.
assigned_files: game/rear_base/base_demo.gd request-selection, vehicle-person choices, truck-status rendering only
game/dispatch/dispatch_service.gd active_handling_status only: detached three-field selected-hull read
accepted_design: Designer direction in chat5November: select successful new request, failed request retains context and reason; distinguish reserved/carried/tank fuel, keep state advice non-mutating, preserve valid physically seated rear extraction. Exact-head approval remains pending.
acceptance: Successful normal request click selects its returned stable ID and immediately renders that request's current receipt/cancel control
Failed command retains existing selection; existing failure message remains visible
T01/T02 status keeps actual tank fuel/Driver, distinguishes pending reservation from carried fuel awaiting tank handoff, renders active selected-hull manifest state/task/blocker
Only living player-owned rear actors with Occupied rear place appear as crew/fuel candidates; seated qualified rear crew remain in crew list for existing safe extraction

ownership.requests: RearLogistics owns request IDs, quantities, delivered counts and statuses; UI owns selection only
ownership.fuel: VehicleActivity/ledger own fuel jobs, reservations, carries and tank receipt; formatter reads supplied row only and never treats commitment as tank fuel
ownership.shipment: Dispatch active_handling_status resolves selected hull through existing _active_manifest once and returns detached state/handling/blocker strings only; no mutable manifest is exposed, no full snapshot.
ownership.crew: Ledger rear_place/owner/health/qualification and existing actor membership; existing allocation/extraction guards stay authoritative

events: Existing successful command immediately refreshes request list once with preferred stable ID; normal scene-owned changed/tab events retain refresh policy. Programmatic ItemList.select does not emit item_selected, so the same explicit refresh renders the selected receipt. No polling/timer/subscriptions added.
cancellation: Failed command cannot change selection. Cancellation remains with current selected request and owner; late/duplicate refresh preserves stable selection. Rear Held Home/None persons are excluded; Occupied seated crew remain selectable for safe extraction under existing stopped-hull rules. No cancellation/allocation semantics changed.

verification.allowed: One brief explicitly supplied current-change demonstration on existing GitHub workflow,45s process limit; changed production parse and strict source/UI maps. No local engine, regression tests/suites, broad scenarios or long workflow
verification.demo: Paused normal main-scene request clicks at two distinct quantities select their returned actual request and show0/N. Pure detached supplied facts demonstrate reserved/carried fuel and active manifest handling/blocker text. No hull/person/stock grants or simulated-time advancement. Demonstration input frozen before execution.
verification.limits: Direct demonstration does not establish physical fuel carry, extraction, two deliveries/returns, ordinary autonomous Army need, native rendering/input,1x pacing or60FPS. Existing full-chain checker remains deferred unchanged.

lessons: Do not infer physical receipt from reservation or available-only stock
Use stable actual identity instead of arbitrary prior/first row
Keep scene refresh finite and owner facts narrow
Preserve physical crew/custody and safe extraction; no new allocation owner

design_correction_contract.acceptance: An idle Parked truck advises inspection of actual Army needs, stock coverage, handling and transport eligibility, and explains enabled automatic fulfilment when physical requirements are met. It infers neither shortage nor a routine manual shipment. Existing explicit manual request control and all owners are unchanged.
design_correction_contract.verification: Source review and required static maps/whitespace only for this wording correction; no rerun/regression/local-engine/full-chain check.
